note: Probes are typed after a run's 60 frozen turns, are not part of the frozen dataset, and are in no bar. Written 2026-11-26, after the first runs were read.

probes.about: the session that received the run's first delivery, by the name the voice gives it
probes.rule: recalled: the reply has at least one word of five letters or more from that first delivered request (its relay prefix left out), and nothing was sent
